finding: Header has no time unit (values 0.05-1.06). FLEX_EIRD_v4.pdf p.20 and Table 13 (p.76) define the droplet burning rate constant k in mm^2/s (d^2-law, consistent with (d0^2 - de^2)/t_burn in the table), showing superscript '2' and '/s' were stripped from the CSV header just like subscript '2' in O2/N2/CO2.
decision: Keep value_num = NULL + unavailable_in_source in run_measurements.csv per strict contract rule (raw text preserved in value_text); document mm^2/s evidence in Data Dictionary for Malak.

column: CO initial ambient composition; mole fraction
finding: CSV header stripped subscript '2' from O2, N2, and CO2. Confirmed by FLEX_EIRD_v4.pdf Section 5.1.4 (p.38) and FLEX_Test_Plan.pdf Tables 8, 11, 12 (pp.8, 14, 15) that the suppressant gas tested with N2/O2 is carbon dioxide (CO2, 0-0.70 mole fraction), while CO is restricted to <0.02 combustion byproduct (FLEX ERD 4.1.51).
decision: Keep measurement variable name co_initial_mole_fraction for backwards compatibility; document in Data Dictionary and Provenance Map that the physical species is CO2 (carbon dioxide diluent/suppressant).

finding: Three categories seen (Disruption, Extinction, Completion), not two as the brief says.
decision: Stored as categorical text in outcome_raw.

finding: 274 data rows vs 275 in the brief.
decision: Use the observed count (274). The brief counted the header row.

finding: Pressure varies across 4 bands: 103 rows ~526-544 mmHg (~70-73 kPa), 161 rows ~752-774 mmHg (~100-103 kPa), 2 rows ~1546-1554 mmHg (~206-207 kPa), 7 rows ~2056-2320 mmHg (~274-309 kPa), plus 1 row at 0 mmHg (I-020).
decision: Headline confirmed: the pressure axis is backed by 273 real microgravity rows.

finding: BASS-II data FAQ.docx defines Fan display as 'instantaneous fan voltage x 10 on the video display (max 122 = 12.2 V) or pot settings (max 10)' and Air display as 'flow speed measured in the duct in cm/s on the video display (slow ~1 min response)'. Many cells list multiple step-changes in free text.
decision: flow_cm_s stays NULL + pending_review (for single numeric air display rows) or not_parseable (for multi-step text) until Malak approves applying U = 1.0066 * Air display.

finding: Fan calibration data.xlsx gives per-restrictor tables and formula 'U = 1.0066 * AIR', noting it is 'Based on SPICE fan calibration data at 56 mm downstream, 36 mm from bottom (centerline)'.
decision: Recorded as a cross-experiment dependency in Data Dictionary and Provenance Map; awaits Malak sign-off before populating flow_cm_s.

finding: Initial and final O2 differ in enclosed burns (e.g. B2 drops 22.2 -> 1.6% vol; T28b rises to 40.4% vol). BASS-II data FAQ.docx notes O2 sensor was offset-calibrated daily against ISS MCA cabin air.
decision: Both stored (o2_vol_pct uses initial with o2_basis='initial'; o2_final_vol_pct in run_measurements.csv). Malak confirms ranking basis.

finding: Non-numeric values: none, video, '300+ +102'.
decision: value_num = NULL + not_reported/not_parseable; raw text preserved in value_text.

finding: -1 values (sensor zero-offset artifact) and 'OR'/'over'/'>500' (BASS-II data FAQ.docx defines OR = over range > 1000 ppm on CSA-CP sensor).
decision: value_num = NULL + invalid_value (for -1 and OR/over) or not_parseable (for >500), flagged negative_gas_reading for -1; raw text kept in value_text.

finding: Present locally in PSI-25 despite v4 archive note. Contains official NASA explanations of every Test Matrix column, sensor calibration, and PI fuel material prior to the publication list.
decision: Used to confirm BASS-II column definitions and resolve PI fuel materials (I-019) as well as for the chatbot text corpus.

finding: 469 rows in CSV vs 526 flames claimed in PSI description (brief says 470, counting header). SPICE Final Report p.14 states 526 flames were studied (listed in Spice Flight Test data II.xls Appendix A), and Dotson thesis Table 3.1 (p.23) summarizes 52 microgravity smoke-point flames across the 5 fuels.
decision: Documented: 469 rows are in the PSI CSV table; the ~57-row difference corresponds to the 52 smoke-point summary records / unexported rows from the original Excel workbook.

finding: 31 groups of identical rows = 34 extra copies (some groups have 3+ copies).
decision: Implemented: first copy marked dup_status='unique', extra copies marked 'exact_duplicate' with dup_of pointing to the first copy.

finding: No run ID column; GMT date is day-of-year (45-174); GMT ignition has 'LOS', 'Ku LOS', 'no ku', 'n/a' and mixed formats. SPICE Final Report p.13 and Dotson thesis p.22 confirm all 12 flight sessions ran Feb 14 - Jun 23, 2009.
decision: Synthetic key D<day>-<time>-R<row> built; test_date populated as 2009-MM-DD from confirmed 2009 flight year + GMT day-of-year (raw day kept in test_date_raw).

finding: '75% Propylene' (16 rows) and '75 % Propylene' (119 rows) are the same fuel (75% C3H6 / 25% N2 mole fraction per SPICE-RPT-002 p.A-19).
decision: Normalised to '75% propylene' in fuel, flagged fuel_label_normalised, raw string preserved in fuel_raw.

finding: 8 negative values (-0.28 on day 136, -5.92 on day 167) and 25 blanks. Dotson thesis Section 3.1.1 (Fig. 3.4, p.27) shows Air Rate is computed from the integer video overlay AIR reading via linear fit u_a = 0.94 * AIR - 5.92 cm/s; AIR=0 yields -5.92 and AIR=6 yields -0.28.
decision: Kept as-is in flow_cm_s and flagged below_physical_range so Malak can decide whether to clamp negative calibration-intercept values to 0 cm/s.

finding: Differs from Fuel Rate (mg/s) in 243 rows (the 50% and 75% propylene/nitrogen blends) where HC is the hydrocarbon-only mass flow rate. 13 rows have 0 (no-ignition/LOS).
decision: Both fuel_rate_mg_s and hc_fuel_rate_mg_s stored in run_measurements.csv.

finding: Python was not installed on this machine. Stage 0 scripts were written in PowerShell.
decision: Python 3.12 installed 2026-11-14. ETL from Stage 2 onward is in Python. Stage 0 PowerShell scripts remain intact.

finding: 28 rows did not include the word 'PMMA' in the cell (e.g. '1/4" black rod', '100 micron film 2 cm wide', '4 cm spherical section'). BASS-II data FAQ.docx explicitly confirms that Bhattacharjee films, Olson clear/black rods, Fernandez-Pello black/clear rods, and T'ien's 4 cm spherical section (Sample 182m, T3/T7) are all PMMA.
decision: Resolved: bass2.py maps film, rod, and spherical section samples to fuel='PMMA' while preserving full geometry/color description in fuel_raw and fuel_detail.

finding: Test 114 (C11M201) has pressure = 0 mmHg, physically impossible for a burning droplet (neighbouring C11M tests are ~535 mmHg).
decision: pressure_kpa = NULL + invalid_value, flagged impossible_value_nulled; run is kept (Contract v0.2).

finding: 23 near-duplicate rows differ only in time separator (14.48.19 vs 14:48:19) or by <=2% in fuel/air rate.
decision: Flagged dup_status='near_duplicate' with dup_of set for Malak; not removed.

finding: 6 rows have O2+N2+CO2+He mole fractions summing to 0.98 (source rounding).
decision: Flagged gas_sum_off; values unchanged.

finding: 2 rows have approximate values '~6' and '~9'.
decision: value_num = NULL + not_parseable; raw text preserved in value_text.

finding: 5 rows have year typos in Date: Olson O20-O22 say '2/26/2016' (GMT=57) and T'ien T9, T18 say '6/24/2018' (GMT=175, adjacent to T10 '6/24/2014' GMT=175). BASS-II ran on ISS in Feb-Aug 2014.
decision: Kept raw date in test_date/test_date_raw without silent correction; flagged date_year_typo_in_source.

finding: Dotson's UMD thesis (Tables 6.3 and 6.4, pp.70-71) contains 36 normal-gravity (1g) smoke-point measurements (15 in the SPICE prototype module on Earth, 21 in an unconfined coflow burner) that are not in the PSI-107 flight CSV.
decision: Documented in Data Dictionary and Coverage Matrix notes; not mixed into flight CSV parser unless requested.

finding: In PSI-101_Experimental table_SAME-R.csv, 'Teflon, 57' is a phantom copy-paste of 'Lampwick, 57' (Rt/R0=1.253), and 'Kapton, 112' is omitted from the CSV but present in Combined SAMER Results 06 02 14.xlsx and the 109-run final report.
decision: Teflon 57 excluded; Kapton 112 added from master workbook and flagged added_from_workbook.

finding: Rows ending in 'a' (e.g. 51a, 61a, 11a) are second aerosol measurements of the parent smoke cloud after additional aging, not independent burns.
decision: Flagged secondary_aging_remeasurement with parent run_id linked in dup_of.

decision: Kept as reported (10 cm/s) and flagged outside_documented_hardware_range for Malak.

decision: Left NULL with flow_missing_reason='not_reported'; never copied across rows.

finding: PSI portal header for PSI-98 copy-pasted PSI-102's title, 2001-2008 dates, and ISS platform, and swapped sample length (40.6 cm) and width (94 cm). True platform is free-flying Cygnus OA-6 on 2016-06-14 (from image log timestamps), and true sample size is 940 mm long x 406 mm wide.
